# Jewish Encyclopedia

> A comprehensive searchable online archive of the complete 1906 Jewish Encyclopedia, covering biographical entries, historical figures, and Jewish heritage across centuries.

This site provides access to the full 1906 Jewish Encyclopedia with alphabetically organized biographical directory entries for Jewish scholars, historical figures, biblical personalities, and communities spanning from ancient times through the 19th century. The encyclopedia covers major geographic centers of Jewish life including Palestine, Israel, Eastern Europe, and Western Europe.

## Key Topics

- Jewish history
- Biographical directory
- Jewish scholars
- Talmudic references
- Biblical figures
- Historical figures
- Jewish communities
- 19th-century Jewish life
- Medieval rabbis
- Palestine and Israel
- Eastern European Jewry
- Jewish biography
- Talmudic scholars
- Historical entries
- Encyclopedia directory

## Core Reference

- [JewishEncyclopedia.com](https://jewishencyclopedia.com): Homepage for complete 1906 Jewish Encyclopedia searchable online archive.

## Biographical Directory - A

- [AACH - Abdima (Abdimi) of Sepphoris](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/1): Biographical directory entries for Jewish figures from Aach to Abdimi.
- [Abdimi Mallaha - ABRAHAM OF BOHEMIA](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/205): Encyclopedia directory entries for Talmudic scholars and biblical figures.
- [ABRAHAM IBN BOLAT - ABRAHAM BEN YOM-TOB OF TUDELA](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/408): Biographical directory of medieval rabbis and Jewish scholars.
- [ABRAHAM ZARFATI - ADLER, DAVID BARUCH](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/611): Alphabetical directory of historical Jewish scholars and figures.
- [ADLER, ELKAN NATHAN - AIN MUSA](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/814): Biographical entries for Adler family and 19th-century prominent Jews.
- [AIRE - ALGAZI, YOM-TOB BEN ISRAEL JACOB](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/1017): Directory of historical Jewish places and medieval European communities.
- [ALGEBRA, SCIENCE OF - AMORITES](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/1220): Encyclopedia entries on Jewish scholars, Hebrew literature, and rabbinic tradition.
- [AMOS - ANTUNES](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/1423): Biblical figures and prophets including Amos, Isaiah, and Moses entries.
- [ANTWERP - ARTAXERXES II](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/1626): Historical places and ancient figures in Jewish and biblical history.
- [ARTAXERXES III - ASSER, CAREL](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/1829): Encyclopedia entries on ancient historical figures and Jewish history.
- [ASSER, CAREL - 'AZZUT PANIM](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/A/2032): Biographical directory of Dutch jurists and 19th-century Jewish scholars.

## Biographical Directory - B

- [BA'AL - BAKHMUT](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/B/2235): Biblical terms and ancient Semitic religious references in Hebrew.
- [BAKI, SIMSON - BARNACLE-GOOSE](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/B/2385): Biographical directory of Jewish historical figures and families.
- [BARNATO, BARNETT ISAACS - BE ABIDAN](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/B/2535): Biographical directory entries for 19th-century Jewish figures.
- [BE RAB - BELMONTE](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/B/2685): Talmudic references, biblical data, and medieval Jewish communities.
- [BELMONTE, B. E. COLACAO - BENJAMIN, SAMUEL](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/B/2835): Belmonte family and Portuguese-Jewish Amsterdam community entries.
- [BERNSTEIN, AARON (DAVID) - BIEDERMANN, MICHAEL LAZAR](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/B/3133): Biographical directory of Bernstein family and 19th-century scholars.
- [BIEGELEISEN, HENRY - BLUMENFELDT, SIMON](https://jewishencyclopedia.com/directory/B/3282): Biographical directory entries for historical Jewish figures and places.
